## Recipe checklist

- [ ] README has every section listed in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, filled in
- [ ] Dependencies pinned and local to the recipe
- [ ] Sample data is public or synthetic, with source noted
- [ ] Ran end to end; hardware, versions, and runtime recorded in the README
- [ ] Smoke test passes
- [ ] No private code, data, or secrets
